coefficient_convention: Difference of two real holomorphic gauge kinetic functions is -P/(8 pi^2), with l1 Taylor coefficient budget for P including the real constant, in dimensionless fields normalized to the 1685 cutoff. For the second class all allowed nonnegative monomials in S,X,A2,A3 are included with the same budget at matching. No bound on an independent bare phase or new CP-odd couplings is assigned.
